nodes.name: task_update.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the task_update tool (status/metadata changes and output submission) with authorization checks and structured rejection responses when an update is not permitted.

nodes.name: TaskUpdateParams
nodes.summary: Parameters for updating a task: id, new status, metadata changes, and optional output.

nodes.name: TaskOutputParams
nodes.summary: Structured output payload a member can attach when completing a task.

nodes.name: TaskUpdateTool
nodes.summary: The task_update tool implementation.

nodes.name: TaskUpdateRejectionCode
nodes.summary: Enum of reasons a task update can be rejected (unauthorized, invalid transition, missing output, etc), each with guidance text.

nodes.name: tasks.rs
nodes.summary: Shared TaskToolsContext and helper functions used by all task_* tools: authorization checks, member/owner resolution, dispatch notifications, and metadata validation for the Agent Org task system.

nodes.name: TaskToolsContext
nodes.summary: Shared context (org state, caller identity) providing authorization and member-resolution helpers used across all task_* tool implementations.

nodes.name: ask_user_questions.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the ask_user_questions tool, letting an agent pause and surface clarifying questions to the human user mid-turn.

nodes.name: QuestionToolContext
nodes.summary: Context (session id, channel) needed to route a question-asking request to the correct UI surface.

nodes.name: QuestionTool
nodes.summary: The ask_user_questions tool implementation.

nodes.name: add_workspace_directory.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the tool that adds an additional allowed directory to a session's channel workspace.

nodes.name: AddWorkspaceDirectoryTool
nodes.summary: The add_workspace_directory tool implementation.

nodes.name: list_known_workspaces.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the tool that lists workspaces known to the current channel/session for the agent to choose from.

nodes.name: ListKnownWorkspacesTool
nodes.summary: The list_known_workspaces tool implementation.

nodes.name: list_session_workspace.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the tool that lists the current session's active workspace directories.

nodes.name: ListSessionWorkspaceTool
nodes.summary: The list_session_workspace tool implementation.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel and shared helpers for the channel workspace-management tools: context-cell access and target-session resolution used by add/list/remove workspace directory tools.

nodes.name: remove_workspace_directory.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the tool that removes a previously added allowed directory from a session's channel workspace.

nodes.name: RemoveWorkspaceDirectoryTool
nodes.summary: The remove_workspace_directory tool implementation.

nodes.name: context_builders.rs
nodes.summary: Builds prompt-injection context sections describing available code accounts, agent definitions, agent orgs, and org members, used to inform subagent and org-tool system prompts.

nodes.name: task_update_rejected_response
nodes.summary: Builds a structured rejection response for a disallowed task update, including the reason code and remediation guidance.

nodes.name: description
nodes.summary: Builds the LLM-facing description text for task_update.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main execution path for task_update: authorizes the change, validates the requested transition/output, and persists the update.

nodes.name: validate_task_output
nodes.summary: Validates that a submitted task output is well-formed and attributable to an authorized producer.

nodes.name: owner_member_id_catalog
nodes.summary: Lists the member ids eligible to be set as a task's owner.

nodes.name: authorized_task_target_catalog
nodes.summary: Lists the member ids the caller is authorized to assign or administer tasks for.

nodes.name: task_authority_summary
nodes.summary: Summarizes the caller's task-administration authority for inclusion in tool descriptions/errors.

nodes.name: unauthorized_task_target_member_ids
nodes.summary: Filters a requested member-id list down to those the caller is NOT authorized to target.

nodes.name: authorization_denied_response
nodes.summary: Builds a structured denial response listing the unauthorized targets and remediation guidance.

nodes.name: can_administer_task
nodes.summary: Checks whether the caller has administrative rights over a given task.

nodes.name: resolve_owner_member_id
nodes.summary: Resolves and validates a raw owner-member-id parameter against the caller's authority.

nodes.name: resolve_eligible_member_ids
nodes.summary: Resolves and validates a list of raw eligible-member-id parameters into authorized member ids.

nodes.name: dispatch_task_assigned_with_sender
nodes.summary: Dispatches task-assignment notifications to eligible members, attributing the dispatch to a specific sender.

nodes.name: dispatch_task_completed
nodes.summary: Dispatches a task-completion notification, including remaining open task count, to interested members.

nodes.name: dispatch_ready_assigned_tasks_unblocked_by
nodes.summary: Finds and dispatches notifications for tasks that became ready to work once a given blocker task resolved.

nodes.name: task_dependencies_resolved
nodes.summary: Checks whether all of a task's blocking dependencies have been resolved.

nodes.name: merge_task_metadata
nodes.summary: Merges new metadata (including eligible-member and output fields) into a task's existing metadata map.

nodes.name: validate_freeform_task_metadata
nodes.summary: Validates that caller-supplied freeform task metadata does not conflict with reserved system fields.

nodes.name: parse_status
nodes.summary: Parses a raw status string parameter into the typed task-status enum.

nodes.name: map_task_write_error
nodes.summary: Maps a task-store write error into the appropriate tool error response.

nodes.name: task_to_json
nodes.summary: Serializes a task record into the JSON shape returned to the LLM.

nodes.name: description
nodes.summary: Builds the LLM-facing description text for ask_user_questions.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Defines the JSON schema of parameters accepted by ask_user_questions (question list, options).

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main execution path for ask_user_questions: publishes the question(s) to the UI and awaits the user's response.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Defines the JSON schema of parameters for add_workspace_directory (the directory path to add).

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main execution path: validates the requested path and adds it to the session's workspace allow-list.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Defines the (empty/minimal) JSON schema of parameters for list_known_workspaces.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main execution path: returns the list of workspaces known to the current channel.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Defines the JSON schema of parameters for list_session_workspace.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main execution path: returns the current session's active workspace directories.

nodes.name: read_ctx
nodes.summary: Reads the shared channel context cell, returning an error if it has not been initialized.

nodes.name: resolve_target_session_id
nodes.summary: Resolves which session id a channel-workspace tool call should target, given app handle, params, and channel context.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Defines the JSON schema of parameters for remove_workspace_directory (the directory path to remove).

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main execution path: validates and removes the requested directory from the session's workspace allow-list.

nodes.name: build_code_accounts_context
nodes.summary: Builds the system-prompt section listing available code accounts/repositories.

nodes.name: build_agent_definitions_context
nodes.summary: Builds the system-prompt section listing available agent definitions a caller may spawn.

nodes.name: build_agent_orgs_context
nodes.summary: Builds the system-prompt section describing the available agent orgs and their structure.

nodes.name: build_members_context
nodes.summary: Builds the system-prompt section listing members of an agent org for a given repo path.
